questions.prompt: Which cost shrinks the pot you win?

choices.text: A drop or percent rake, up to the cap.
A time charge that never touches the pot
Folding before you put chips in

questions.explanation: Pot rake comes out of the pot. A time charge is paid separately.

questions.prompt: Which game is less harsh on small speculative pots?

choices.text: A time-rake game, because the pot is not reduced. The players are often better.
A high drop on every $1/$2 hand
A game that rakes 100% of the pot

questions.explanation: Time rake taxes the seat, not the small pot. Skill still has to be there.

choices.text: The decisions, the rake, and the tips. Not one lucky pot.
The jackpot you did not hit

questions.explanation: A winning night can be a bad decision if you paid too much rake at the wrong stake.

questions.prompt: The economic check before you sit is…

choices.text: Can I lose a buy-in here without changing how I live, at a rake I understand?
Are the chips a nicer color
Is the stake the highest in the room

questions.explanation: If the answer is no, the strategy lesson does not matter yet.
